mode: engineering delivery; assisted implementation and interpretation, not independent student assessment
scope: post-hoc decision analysis of existing, already explored development predictions; not new validation

source_clinic.authorship: source received in Downloads; original author not established by file content; byte-preserving copy performed with Codex assistance

joint_lesson_lookup: No matching *M02*M03*M05* lesson found in targeted docs and Downloads search; local M05 quantile/event lessons consulted. This is not proof that no attachment exists elsewhere.

generation_decisions.selected_steps: timestamp target-history_end equals 26 hours; zero-based index25 fixed by h24/d2 source contract
generation_decisions.quantile_selection: direct native levels p20/p50/p80 in archived grid; no interpolation, quantile sorting, clipping or mass assignment
generation_decisions.blocks: seven chronological blocks of24 origins, descriptive stability only

event_decisions.event: last_available_generation-target_generation>=22.77 MWmed, endpoint26h after history_end; not hourly ramp
event_decisions.thresholds: compare fixed0.5 with theoretical cost_fp/(cost_fp+cost_fn); deduplicate identical thresholds
event_decisions.tie_rule: alarm when p_event>=threshold; equal expected costs permit either action at equality
event_decisions.probability_source: saved classifier p_event only; never inferred from p10/p50/p90 or Chronos quantiles

cost_units: hypothetical relative costs; weighted MWmed for generation; arbitrary units for classification, never currency
criteria_before_calculation: source output hashes match historical receipt and remain unchanged
same origins, targets and observations within each separate cohort
all selected decisions and losses finite
native quantile p50 equals archived point forecast
class probabilities in[0,1], labels binary and label thresholds preserved
threshold policy ties and cohort differences stated
no retraining, inference, calibration, tuning, source edits or operational approval
